topics.title: Write a Fact File about an Ancient Invention
guiding_questions: When and where was it invented?
topics.sample_essay: The wheel is a great ancient invention. It was invented in Mesopotamia about 5000 years ago. People used it for carts and pottery. The wheel helped people carry heavy things easily. It also made travel faster and safer. Today, wheels are used in cars, bikes and machines. It is one of the greatest inventions ever.

topics.title: Write a Diary about How You Manage and Organise Your Time
guiding_questions: How do you divide your tasks?
What time stealers do you avoid?
Who helps you organise your time?
How do you feel about your progress?
topics.sample_essay: Dear diary, today I organised my time well. I woke up early and studied two hours. Then I helped my mother. I did not waste time on my phone. I finished all my homework before dinner. I felt proud of myself. Tomorrow I will do the same. Time is precious. I must use it wisely.
